notes.title: Gachi Bird IS HERE
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41341189/d96558921148cd949c77ca79d615cf0c74e0ee7d.png[/img]
It's here... 
The moment came.... 
We all waited long enough, we all had our thoughts, worries and troubles. 
But today!
We can move this things aside and have the time of our lives. 
Play Gachi Bird. 
Have fun. 
Aniki

notes.title: LAST PRERELEASE UPDATE 1.0.7
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41341189/d96558921148cd949c77ca79d615cf0c74e0ee7d.png[/img]
HOPE YOU ARE READY FOR THIS!!!!!
With the last prerelease update I added a New Game mode - [b]♂️DJ VAN MODE ♂️[/b]!!!!!!! 
Now you can literally create your own Gachi Remix on the fly (:
For now there is going to be 9 ♂️GACHI ♂️sounds we all love and one of the most insane music loops. It's gonna be a banger xdddddddddd
Not gonna spoil you the sounds themselves, but here is a sneak peak of how it's going to look!
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41341189/ba10690355abe75cfe4c56385234009a98dbcdb8.png[/img]
Here you can see - in the top right corner VAN is doing his thing. If you click on him:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41341189/3408b2fbcc4660ad7069f732c26117b0ffe2c3df.png[/img]
And the rest is up to you (:

notes.title: GACH BIRD IS COMMING!!!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41341189/d96558921148cd949c77ca79d615cf0c74e0ee7d.png[/img]
5 days left, less then a week???!!!?!!
I can't believe it either. ♂️[b]Gachi Bird[/b]♂️ is coming out so soon, you won't be able to watch even 1 Gachi film. You will be able to play all your favourite characters in ♂️[b]Gym[/b]♂️, endless mode, cry a bit in ♂️[b]Heaven mode[/b]♂️, sweat a lot in ♂️[b]Hell mode[/b]♂️. It's gonna be ♂️fun♂️, I really hope you'll like it.
